A Myriad MyChoice CDx GIS >=42 (or equivalent FDA companion diagnostic) is still required to establish formal HRD-positive eligibility for olaparib + bevacizumab (PAOLA-1).

Below the IHC 3+ threshold of the tumor-agnostic trastuzumab-deruxtecan approval, so HER2-directed ADCs are investigational in this ovarian tumor (cross-tumor extrapolation from breast HER2-low). A confirmatory HER2 re-stain would harden the call given the single-specimen basis.

targetable_features.feature: HRD / homologous-recombination status (genomic instability present, BRCA wild-type) — RESOLVED
targetable_features.rationale: Tumor NGS now resolves the question that previously gated the case: the tumor is BRCA-proficient (germline AND somatic BRCA wild-type) but genomically unstable (multiple chromosomal imbalances / LOH). This supports a genomic-instability-based PARP-maintenance rationale and the report explicitly names niraparib and olaparib. niraparib (PRIMA, all-comers) does not require a BRCA mutation or a validated HRD score and is the cleanest fit. BRCA-mutation-gated olaparib monotherapy (SOLO1) is foreclosed. olaparib + bevacizumab (PAOLA-1) remains contingent on obtaining a validated genomic-instability score (e.g. Myriad MyChoice CDx GIS >=42), which Altera's qualitative call does not establish.

Patient is already receiving bevacizumab; VEGF is an established actionable maintenance axis in advanced HGSC (bevacizumab maintenance; combinable with PARP inhibitor in HRD-positive disease). In scope for maintenance strategy.

ER-positive HGSC provides a low-toxicity endocrine-therapy rationale (e.g. aromatase inhibition) as a maintenance or later-line option, attractive given the patient's age and stated preference for low-burden, oral therapy. PR-negativity tempers expected magnitude.

Newly identified focal somatic amplification on tumor NGS. No approved PI3K/AKT/mTOR-directed therapy in HGSC, but the Altera report lists early-phase PI3K-pathway trials. Low-priority, investigational-only axis; surfaced for completeness.

Newly identified focal somatic deletion on tumor NGS, with early-phase trials listed on the Altera report. No approved matched therapy; low-priority, investigational-only axis surfaced for completeness.

Active investigational IL-12 immunogene therapy (GEN-1 / IMNN-01); relevant to immunotherapy-combination reasoning and to the board's on-study context, though not a standard-of-care target. Note MSS / TMB-low status argues against single-agent checkpoint inhibition.

Tumor HER2 IHC is 1+ in an ER-positive, PR-negative HGSOC. Under Libby's HER2 status classification this is HER2-low, not HER2-negative, even though the surgical-pathology report scored 1+ as 'negative' using ASCO-CAP gastric / DESTINY-PanTumor scoring. HER2-low is an actionable expression tier: in breast cancer it is on-label for trastuzumab deruxtecan (DESTINY-Breast04; HER2-ultralow per DESTINY-Breast06). In ovarian and other non-breast solid tumors the tumor-agnostic T-DXd approval requires IHC 3+, so for this HER2-low 1+ tumor any HER2-directed ADC is investigational / trial-eligibility, supported by cross-tumor extrapolation from the breast HER2-low evidence. Specimen caveat: the Altera platform could not evaluate HER2 (insufficient material), so the 1+ rests on a single surgical-path IHC and a confirmatory re-stain would harden the call.
